input: A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only if /world/E<n>/hp.num is less than or equal to the /world/<E>/hp.num of every other living enemy (where /world/<E>/alive.bool is true), so the squad finishes the weakest enemy, such as E0 at 9hp, instead of switching away and leaving it alive. (Writing the formula: num_*, bool_* and text_* predicates read the contract's accepted state, from before the commit being checked, so they never see the value a commit writes. To test the order a commit writes, use +sets(/orders/<unit>.text, "<order>"). Paths: /world/step.num /world/allies_alive.num /world/enemies_alive.num /world/focus.text /world/<unit>/hp.num /world/<unit>/alive.bool /world/<A>/closest.text /world/<A>/in_range.num /orders/<A>.text)
response: always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") +num_gt(/world/E0/hp.num, /world/E1/hp.num) +bool_true(/world/E1/alive.bool)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") +num_gt(/world/E0/hp.num, /world/E2/hp.num) +bool_true(/world/E2/alive.bool)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") +num_gt(/world/E1/hp.num, /world/E0/hp.num) +bool_true(/world/E0/alive.bool)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") +num_gt(/world/E1/hp.num, /world/E2/hp.num) +bool_true(/world/E2/alive.bool)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") +num_gt(/world/E2/hp.num, /world/E0/hp.num) +bool_true(/world/E0/alive.bool)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") +num_gt(/world/E2/hp.num, /world/E1/hp.num) +bool_true(/world/E1/alive.bool)] false)
